SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
No. U. 234
Date. 20-3-43

Foreign Affairs Station/ File No. Date March 11-th, 1943.

SUBJECT: Re Attached Communication from Heinz GLASER,
applying for a Testimony of Conduct.

1. Name of applicant:- Heinz Glaser,
2. Address:- 421 Lane, House No.15 Ward Road.
3. Application for:- Testimony of Conduct from the Commissioner of Police.
4. Object:- Having one previous conviction, he has difficulty to obtain employment.

（批：林熊祥后启祝名）
（印：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER OF POLICE SHANGHAI 11 MAR 43）

COMMENT.

Heinz GLASER alias GANTHER was arrested on the 16-th of July, 1941, and charged with Misappropriation of two typewriters from 685/70 East Seward Road. He appeared before the S.S.D. Court on the 17-th of July and was sentenced to 3 months imprisonment. (Please see F.I.R. I2I3/41 Wayside St. C.R.O.No. F. 3684). He was released from the Ward Road Gaol on the 16-th of October, 1941. Born on the 25-th of March, 1903 at Breslau, Germany, of Jewish parents.

It can be stated that it appears to be a case of impertinence from the applicant to request from the Commissioner of Police a testimony of conduct in which his previous conviction should be avoided, in order that he might obtain employment. In other words he wants the C.P. to issue him a false document.

It would be much easier for the applicant to state the true facts of his previous conduct to his employer-to-be and ask him to forget about it, promissing to be honest in the future.

The undersigned respectfully suggests that the issue of a Testimony of Conduct should be refused or if issued to include the one previous conviction.

Eygaison
D.S.I.
（印：OK）

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs Section,
Crime & Special Branches.

（左侧框内文字：上海公共租界工部局警务处 犯罪及特别支部 第三科）
Officer i/c Foreign Crime,
Crime & Special Branch, S.M.P.

(S.D.) REGIS
DATE 20 3 43

外事股/ 档案号 日期 1943年3月11日。

事由：关于海因茨·格拉泽（Heinz GLASER）附函申请品行证明书一事。

1. 申请人姓名：- 海因茨·格拉泽（Heinz Glaser），
2. 地址：- 华德路421弄15号。
3. 申请事项：- 向警务处处长申请品行证明书。
4. 目的：- 因有一次前科，难以获得就业。

（批：林熊祥后启祝名）
（印：上海警务处处长办公室 1943年3月11日）

意见。

海因茨·格拉泽（Heinz GLASER），别名甘瑟（GANTHER），于1941年7月16日被捕，被控从西华德路685/70号盗用两台打字机。他于7月17日出庭受审于特别巡捕法庭（S.S.D. Court），并被判处监禁三个月。（请参阅 FIR I2I3/41 韦斯特路 C.R.O.编号 F. 3684）。他于1941年10月16日从华德路监狱获释。1903年3月25日出生于德国布雷斯劳（Breslau），父母均为犹太人。

可以说，申请人要求警务处处长出具一份不包含其前科记录的品行证明书以便求职，此举实属无礼。换言之，他希望警务处处长为其出具一份虚假文件。

申请人若能向未来的雇主如实陈述其过往行为的事实，并请求对方予以谅解，同时承诺今后诚实做人，事情会容易得多。

签署人谨建议拒绝签发品行证明书，或者如果签发，应包含那一次前科记录。

艾盖森（Eygaison）
副督察长（D.S.I.）
（印：OK）

犯罪及特别支部外事股主管，

（左侧框内文字：上海公共租界工部局警务处 犯罪及特别支部 第三科）
上海公共租界工部局警务处犯罪及特别支部外罪股主管

（签名）雷吉斯（REGIS）
日期 1943年3月20日

Heinz Glaser
21/15 Ward Road

Shanghai, 26th February, 1943

（印：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER OF POLICE / MAR / SHANGHAI）

To the
Commissioner of Police

Sir,

I herewith apply for a testimony of conduct in
order to get an employment as salesman. I have to point out that
I served three month in jail in 1941. That was my only penalty
and there wont be another one.

When it happened I could not stop the sentence
in due time for the accuser acted very ill-natured. I was not
innocent but I had no chance to settle the matter.

In order to get the employment in question the
sentence must not be mentioned in the testimony of conduct although
the manager of the firm knows about. He trusts me and he wants to
give me a chance but the testimony of conduct has to be produced
to the owner of the firm.

Therefore I ask you kindly to abandon the mention-
ing of my served sentence in the testimony of conduct otherwise I
wont be able to get the job and I wont have a chance, after a long
time being out of job, to start a new life again.

Thanking you in anticipation, I remain, Sir,

Respectfully yours

Heinz Glaser

海因茨·格拉泽
华德路21/15号

上海，1943年2月26日

（印：警务处处长办公室 / 三月 / 上海）

致
警务处处长

先生，

我特此申请一份品行证明书，以便获得一份推销员的职位。我必须指出，我曾在1941年服刑三个月。那是我唯一的刑罚，且不会再有第二次。

当此事发生时，由于原告行为极其恶劣，我未能及时阻止判决。我并非无辜，但我没有机会解决此事。

为了获得上述工作，品行证明书中不得提及该判决，尽管公司经理已知晓此事。他信任我，并希望给我一个机会，但必须向公司业主出示品行证明书。

因此，我恳请您在品行证明书中省略对我已服刑期的提及，否则我将无法得到这份工作，而在长期失业之后，我也将没有机会重新开始新生活。

预先致谢，先生，

您忠实的仆人

海因茨·格拉泽

Sir,

In reply to your letter dated February 26,
1943, applying for a testimony of conduct, I am
directed to inform you that the certificates of
character issued by the Police must contain all
the facts obtainable which will include your pre-
vious convictions.

Under the circumstances, the Police are
unable to accede to your request.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Secretary to
